'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russo-Ukrainian war (2022–present)|Russo-Ukrainian war]]
**[[Kyiv strikes (2022–present)|Kyiv strikes]], [[Russian strikes against Ukrainian infrastructure]]
***Two people are killed and 32 are injured during a [[Russian Armed Forces|Russian]] missile and drone strike on [[Kyiv]], [[Ukraine]]. Damage to [[critical infrastructure]] leaves 40% of Kyiv's residential areas and surrounding [[Districts of Ukraine|districts]] without [[Heating, ventilation, and air conditioning|heating]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c1dzvpg1341o (BBC News)]
**[[Denis Kapustin (militant)|Denis Kapustin]], leader of the [[Ukraine]]-aligned [[neo-Nazism|neo-Nazi]] [[Russian Volunteer Corps]], is reported to have been killed in a Russian [[drone strike]] in [[Zaporizhzhia Oblast]]. It is later revealed that Kapustin had faked his death in order to thwart an assassination attempt. [https://kyivindependent.com/ukraines-hur-faked-death-of-top-anti-putin-russian-commander-claimed-kremlin-bounty-money/ (''The Kyiv Independent'')] [https://www.themoscowtimes.com/2025/12/27/leader-of-russian-volunteer-corps-killed-fighting-for-kyiv-a91564 (''The Moscow Times'')]
*[[Sudanese civil war (2023–present)|Sudanese civil war]]
**[[Darfur genocide (2023–present)|Darfur genocide]]
***The [[Rapid Support Forces]] kill over 200 civilians in ethnically motivated attacks targeting non-[[Sudanese Arabs|Arabs]] in [[West Darfur]] and during advances in [[North Darfur]], according to the [[Sudan Doctors Union]]. [https://tribune.com.pk/story/2584217/over-200-killed-in-ethnic-attacks-by-sudans-rsf-in-darfur-doctors-group-says (''The Express Tribune'')]
*[[2023 Nigerien coup d'état]], [[Islamist insurgency in Niger]]
**The [[Niger]]ien [[Government of Niger|government]] declares a nationwide mobilization that authorizes the [[conscription]] of citizens and the [[Eminent domain|requisition of property]] and services to support operations against [[Jihadism|jihadist]] [[Insurgency|insurgent]] groups. [https://www.france24.com/en/africa/20251227-niger-junta-orders-general-mobilisation-in-fight-against-jihadists (AFP via France 24)]
*[[2025 Cambodia–Thailand conflict]]
**[[Cambodia]] and [[Thailand]] sign a new [[ceasefire]] agreement, calling for a pause in military movements and [[airspace]] encroachment for military purposes. [https://apnews.com/article/thailand-cambodia-border-fighting-ceasefire-0019310e1c062cd211f9f5398b3bc463 (AP)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[Cross-strait relations]], [[China–United States relations]]
**[[China]] sanctions 20 [[United States]] [[arms industry|defense]]-related companies and ten executives for providing weapons to [[Taiwan]] last week. [https://apnews.com/article/china-sanctions-us-companies-arm-sale-taiwan-31e1bdef85a4cae9a765b189497ca3bf (AP)]
*[[Lithium mining in Chile]]
**[[Chile]]an state-owned [[Mining in Chile|mining]] company [[Codelco]] and private miner [[Sociedad Química y Minera|SQM]] create a [[joint venture]] to develop [[lithium]] in the [[Salar de Atacama|Atacama]] [[Salt pan (geology)|salt flat]] until 2060, with the Chilean state set to receive the majority of [[operating margin]]s. [https://www.barrons.com/news/chilean-firms-announce-creation-of-giant-company-to-exploit-lithium-4f031d54 (AFP via ''Barron's'')]
*[[Trade policy of China]]
**The [[National People's Congress]] of [[China]] passes a revised [[trade law]] that will expand [[Government of China|the government]]'s authority to counter [[Chinese government sanctions|trade restrictions]], regulate [[List of exports of China|exports]] of [[Strategic material|strategic goods]], and update provisions on [[Electronic trading|digital]], [[Green trading|green]], and [[Intellectual property in China|intellectual-property]] trade from March 1, 2026. [https://www.reuters.com/world/china/china-passes-revised-foreign-trade-law-bolster-trade-war-capabilities-2025-12-27/ (Reuters)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*Fifteen people are killed and 19 more injured as a bus plunges in to a [[ravine]] while driving on the [[Inter-American Highway]] in [[Sololá Department]], [[Guatemala]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2025/12/27/at-least-15-dead-19-injured-in-guatemala-as-bus-plunges-into-ravine (Al Jazeera)]
*An accident involving two cars after an improper [[overtaking]] kills eleven people on the [[BR-101 (Brazil highway)|BR-101 highway]] near [[Mucuri]], [[Bahia]], [[Brazil]]. [https://noticias.uol.com.br/cotidiano/ultimas-noticias/2025/12/27/acidente-na-br-101-mata-11-pessoas-na-bahia-incluindo-gestante-e-criancas.htm (UOL)]
*At least nine people are killed and eight others are injured when a bus carrying 19 [[Charitable organization|charity workers]] overturns on a mountain in Phình Hồ, [[Lào Cai province]], [[Vietnam]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/least-7-killed-vietnam-after-bus-overturns-2025-12-27/ (Reuters)] [https://news.tuoitre.vn/9-killed-8-injured-after-bus-carrying-charity-group-overturns-in-northern-vietnam-103251227142029558.htm (''Tuổi Trẻ'')]
*Three of five members of a Spanish tourist family are killed after a boat carrying eleven people sinks near [[Padar (island)|Padar]], [[Indonesia]]. [https://apnews.com/article/indonesia-spanish-tourists-boat-sinking-e9f73a308eff6e1f84df5713a22f5fb4 (AP)]
*A {{M|w|7.0}} [[earthquake]], rated intensity four on the [[Central Weather Administration seismic intensity scale]], strikes {{cvt|32|km|mi|abbr=on}} off the coast of [[Yilan City|Yilan]], [[Taiwan]], causing a temporary [[power outage]] for over 3,000 households. [https://www.dw.com/en/70-magnitude-earthquake-rattles-taiwan/a-75317087 (DW)] [https://edition.cnn.com/2025/12/27/asia/taiwan-earthquake-tremors-intl-latam (CNN)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Oil smuggling in Iran]]
**The [[Iran]]ian [[Ministry of Justice (Iran)|justice ministry]] seizes a foreign-flagged [[oil tanker]] carrying 25,000 [[oil barrel|barrels]] traveling through the [[Strait of Hormuz]] and detains its sixteen crew members on allegations of carrying illegal items. [https://apnews.com/article/iran-seizure-oil-tanker-hormuz-strait-16f0c69a2314c17dcc08149b10861fa3 (AP)]
*A joint operation between the [[Italy|Italian]] [[Polizia di Stato|state police]] and the [[Guardia di Finanza|financial police]] results in the arrest of nine people for allegedly raising about {{Euro}}7 million (US$8.2 million) through charities and diverting most of the funds to [[Hamas]] following the [[October 7 attacks|2023 attack]] on [[Israel]]. [https://www.upi.com/Top_News/World-News/2025/12/27/italy-hamas-fundraisers/8881766869202/ (UPI)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2025 Ivorian parliamentary election]]
**Citizens of the [[Ivory Coast]] vote for the 255 members of the [[National Assembly (Ivory Coast)|National Assembly]] despite the opposition [[Democratic Party of Ivory Coast – African Democratic Rally|Democratic Party]] boycotting due to alleged [[election fraud]] by the ruling [[Rally of Houphouëtists for Democracy and Peace|RHDP]] party. [https://www.dw.com/en/cote-divoire-election-held-amid-opposition-boycott/a-75314914 (DW)]
*The [[Italian Parliament]] approves a reform that reduces the powers of the [[Court of Audit (Italy)|Court of Audit]] over [[public spending]], caps financial penalties for [[Negligence|negligent]] administrators at 30% of losses or two years of salary, and introduces automatic approval if the court does not respond within 30 days. [https://www.reuters.com/world/italy-loosens-court-control-over-public-tenders-amid-protests-2025-12-27/ (Reuters)]
